Examplar Chemical Company Reactor Fire

Accident Occurred On03/09/2025
LocationHarbor City, TX
Accident TypeFire and Explosion
Investigation StatusThe CSB's final report was released on May 20, 2026.
Final Report Released On05/20/2026
CompanyExamplar Chemical Company
FacilityExamplar Harbor City Plant

Key Findings

  1. The reactor's high-temperature interlock had been bypassed for maintenance and was not restored.
  2. The facility's management of change procedure did not address temporary bypasses of safety instrumented functions.

Causal Factors

  • Inadequate control of safety system bypasses, contrary to the good practice described in API RP 754.

Recommendations

NumberRecipientStatusStatus DateText
2026-02-I-TX-R1Examplar Chemical CompanyOpen - Awaiting Response05/20/2026Implement a bypass authorization program for safety instrumented functions at the Harbor City Plant.
2026-02-I-TX-R2American Petroleum InstituteOpen - Acceptable Response or Alternate Response07/01/2026Revise API RP 754 to address temporary bypasses of safety instrumented functions.
